Reported bugs fixed:
- Looted chests lost their check marks after logging back in, mostly on a server: the mod chose the world before its Flame Altars had loaded, started a second record for the same world, and from then on each session used whichever record the loaded altars matched. It now waits for the altars to load, and a world's split records are joined into one the first time you join with its altars loaded, keeping every check mark. Check marks made in a session that saw only one altar stay in that session's own record.
